note: Infrastructure clouds without the breadth of the global clouds. A self-managed service runs on your own server or container; the report says you run, patch and back it up yourself.

server: Builds and runs your containers with automatic deploys, HTTPS and scaling.

serverless.caveat: Each invocation has a time limit, and streaming routes need testing.
